about.title: From a single studio to an index of ventures.
about.desc: Same craft and ownership standards, now spread across seven teams instead of one.
about.copy: Glazni started as a mobile-first software studio in Moscow, building fast, native-feeling Android and iOS apps — plus the websites, desktop tools, and infrastructure around them — for clients across Russia, Germany and the rest of Europe. As that studio grew, the teams around it — marketing, talent, hospitality tech, design, privacy-first computing, and website migration — grew into ventures of their own. Glazni is now the holding company that sits above all of them: still rooted in Moscow, with Berlin as its European hub and remote coverage across the rest of the continent.

culture.title: Independently run

process.desc: The same path every venture in the index has taken so far.

steps.title: Identify

steps.desc: The venture draws on Glazni Talent and the shared engineering backbone so it can grow without rebuilding the basics.

hero.title: Where Glazni started, and where most of it still runs.
hero.sub: Before there was a holding company, there was a small studio in Moscow building fast, native-feeling iOS and Android apps. That's still what Glazni Apps does — for clients, and occasionally for ourselves.
hero.ctaTalk: Talk to us about a build

build.title: Native apps, built the way the original studio built them.
build.p1: The team behind Glazni Apps ships production iOS and Android software on Flutter, Golang and AWS — the same stack the studio was founded on. A number of these apps are live on the App Store and Google Play today, and several more are in active development.
build.p2: Most of what we build is commissioned work: client products we design, ship and maintain under our own name or theirs. What's public and what isn't is a decision each client makes, not us.

private.title: We don't list or link to our own apps here.
private.desc: If you already have a link to one of our apps, that link works. This site just won't hand it to you.
private.notice: most of what we build is client work, and several of our own apps are still early or invite-based. Rather than publish a partial, half-public list, we simply don't route traffic to any Glazni-built app from this website. If you were sent a Play Store or App Store link directly, it's valid — go ahead and open it. Nothing here will redirect you to one.

rebuild.title: Already have a product? We'll rebuild it properly.
rebuild.p1: Not every engagement starts from a blank page. A good share of our client work is re-engineering: taking an existing website, app or internal tool that's grown slow, brittle or outdated, and rebuilding it on a stack that can actually be maintained.
rebuild.p2: If that's what you need, this is the venture to talk to — same team, same standards, applied to something that already exists.

announce.title: What the team is building right now
announce.itemDesc: We're building a language-learning app in-house. It's early — no public link yet, and no date to share — but it'll follow the same privacy-first approach as everything else Glazni ships.
